layout.body:
David White
I have exciting news for all fitness enthusiasts and those looking to start their wellness journey.
I am thrilled to announce the opening of my new fitness studio, Flex & Flow, located right in the heart of downtown Toronto! Our grand opening will be next Saturday, and we have an amazing lineup of activities to celebrate.
Take advantage of free workout classes, where you can participate in yoga, pilates, and strength training. Meet our special guest trainers and learn from the best in the business. You can also enjoy free nutritious snacks provided by local vendors.
Flex & Flow is all about creating a supportive community where you can achieve your fitness goals while having fun. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just beginning, we have something for everyone.
For more details and to RSVP, visit our website at www.flexandflow.ca.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the social media post?

options.A: To announce an upcoming fitness competition
options.B: To introduce a newly hired fitness trainer
options.D: To advertise the opening of a new fitness studio

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the social media post? 原文依据： I am thrilled to announce the opening of my new fitness studio, Flex & Flow, located right in the heart of downtown Toronto! Our grand opening will be next Saturday, and we have an amazing lineup of activities to celebrate. 翻译： 我非常激动地宣布，我的新健身工作室 Flex & Flow 正式开业，它就位于多伦多市中心的核心地带！我们的盛大开业仪式将在下周六举行，我们准备了一系列精彩的活动来庆祝。 选项分析： (A) To announce an upcoming fitness competition 宣布即将到来的健身比赛 → 错误（帖子核心是宣布健身工作室开业，而非比赛） (B) To introduce a newly hired fitness trainer 介绍新聘用的健身教练 → 错误（仅提到特邀教练，未介绍新聘用教练） (C) To promote online workout classes 推广线上健身课程 → 错误（帖子未提及线上课程，仅提到开业现场的免费课程） (D) To advertise the opening of a new fitness studio 宣传一家新健身工作室的开业 → 正确

questions.stem: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of the event?

options.B: A presentation about nutrition and health

questions.analysis: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of the event? 原文依据： Take advantage of free workout classes, where you can participate in yoga, pilates, and strength training. Meet our special guest trainers and learn from the best in the business. You can also enjoy free nutritious snacks provided by local vendors. 翻译： 享受免费的健身课程，你可以参与瑜伽、普拉提和力量训练。与我们的特邀教练见面，向行业内最优秀的人士学习。你还可以享用当地供应商提供的免费营养零食。 选项分析： (A) Free workout classes 免费健身课程 → 提及（原文明确提到） (B) A presentation about nutrition and health 关于营养与健康的演讲 → 未提及（原文仅提到免费营养零食，未提到相关演讲） (C) Special guest trainers 特邀教练 → 提及（原文明确提到） (D) Free food 免费食物 → 提及（原文提到免费营养零食，属于免费食物）

questions.stem: Who is the social media post intended for?

options.B: People who want to be fit

questions.analysis: Who is the social media post intended for? 原文依据： I have exciting news for all fitness enthusiasts and those looking to start their wellness journey. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just beginning, we have something for everyone. 翻译： 我有一个令人兴奋的消息要告诉所有健身爱好者和那些想要开启健康之旅的人。无论你是经验丰富的运动员还是刚刚起步，我们都有适合你的项目。 选项分析： (A) Local restaurant owners 当地餐馆老板 → 错误（与帖子核心受众无关） (B) People who want to be fit 想要健身的人 → 正确（帖子面向健身爱好者和想要开启健康之旅的人，即想要健身的人） (C) Healthcare professionals 医疗保健专业人员 → 错误（帖子未针对医疗专业人员） (D) Sports equipment vendors 运动器材供应商 → 错误（与帖子核心受众无关）
